contract.selected: Exact Utleie parent selected, or structured agreed document addon with no explicit refusal/unknown parent
contract.not_selected: Explicit refusal overrides listing; selected and refused yields unknown/conflict; explicit unknown without selected blocks listing
contract.non_choice: Descriptions/details/general terms/catalog availability/old IDs never select; local headings require documented Utleie context
contract.source_binding: Persist agreed-addon Utleie:Valgt at original record boundary before consolidation; preserve role, side, source references and existing object matching
contract.repeat: Five existing catalog details keep key/value/full sources/notes/catalog origin and deductible override across repeats and JSON; a document-generated root ID does not become manual proof
contract.customer_priority: Exact scoped detail identities preserve customer values and sources, including unknown without catalog/supporting fallback; no duplicate generic detail identities
contract.supporting: Generic parent cannot supply choice; detail identity deduplicates and generic evidence stays in recordEvidence/supportingEvidence
contract.manual: Strict manual proof and malformed/missing/cross-addon rejection unchanged, including alongside document Valgt. All 214 frozen manual outputs/displays remain exact
contract.meaning: Choice does not prove certificate registration or entitlement. Premium/general deductible/base rental loss/HTU/source meaning unchanged
contract.schema: No new global parent/enum/alias; unchanged extraction schema, source admission and house matching

publication_revision: Containing Git commit; effective after verification on remote main
